g.text: Recipe (one vs two option orders averaged)
Latency per request vs answer-set size, one NVIDIA A40
One record at a time through the served path. Every option is scored, so K is the cost axis; the option text is in the prompt, so prefill grows with K. Jev's line is its API round trip as
observed by our client -- network included.
